You can have two flags on the same side in semaphore, just not in the same position: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_semaphore.  By my reckoning, 8:53 would be O, or possibly I.

Decoding all the times as semaphore, I get OLSDNLEDI, or possibly OESDNEEDI, depending on how you interpret 7:08.  You could also call 5:40 an A, and get OLSDALEDI or OESDAEEDI.

 

Any of those mean anything to anyone?

posts.cooked:
Foote:

wait…can someone explain how they put the semi-whatchyacallits into the cipher? 

 

Reading from 1 to 9, the semaphore letters were OLSDALEDI.  How a railfence cipher is that you read the encrypted text by row from top to bottom, filling in so that you move up and down the rows.  If you use 3 levels it looks like this:

O        L        S

   D   A   L   E

     D         I

 

You then read from left to right going up and down the fence as needed and it reads ODDALLIES.
